create_AtekWdsStreamDataset: create an AtekWdsStreamDataset instance to stream webdataset snippets with configurable length and stride
use_batchify: use batchify to add a batch dimension to all tensors in a datum dictionary
use_unbatchify: use unbatchify to remove the batch dimension from all tensors in a datum dictionary
iterate_AtekWdsStreamDataset: iterate over an AtekWdsStreamDataset to yield time-cropped snippets from WDS tar archives
sample_snippet: call sample_snippet_ to time-crop a snippet by start and end frame indices
